7. Let the applicant Sharafat be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 341 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. (b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is argued that applicant had given an application to the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and the Superintendent of Police, Amroha on 18.6.2022 on the complaint portal of the Government stating of the first informant being a lady of bad character and that he was previously implicated by her in a case of rape after which she took money and got it settled after which the applicant was challaned under Section 151/107/116 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is argued that subsequently the FIR has been lodged after about six months by falsely implicating the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Although the victim has named the applicant and stated of his committing rape upon her in her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. but the same is false version as the medical examination report of the victim does not show any injury either on her body or on her private part.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: The implication of the applicant is false and with malafide intention.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

It has also been pointed out that the applicant is not having any criminal history as stated in para 21 of the affidavit and is in jail since 7.2.2023.
7.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Per contra learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the victim is aged about 15 years as has been opined by the C.M.O concerned.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The applicant is named in the FIR, in the statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C.
There are allegations of committing rape by the applicant upon the victim, as such bail application of the applicant be rejected.
8.

sentences.text: After hearing the counsel for the parties and perusing the record, it is apparent that the victim is minor aged about 15 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is named in the FIR, in the statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. and there are allegations of committing rape by the applicant upon the victim.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: In so far as the previous application of the applicant given on portal of the Government is concerned, the same is against the first informant.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: The victim in no manner would have joined the hands at this age for falsely implicating the applicant and also making her involved in a matter of rape.
sentences._hearing_file: Sharafat vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: 8. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I do not find it a fit case for bail, hence, the bail application is rejected.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant-Sharafat, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No.809 of 2022 under Section 328, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, registered at Police Station Gajraula, District Amroha.
Notice was issued to the first informant vide order dated 11.7.2023.
5. The FIR of the matter was lodged on 11.12.2022 by Kausar Jahan against the applicant on the basis of application moved under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. alleging therein that on 14.6.2022 at about 1 p.m. when her daughter having date of birth 26.3.2010 was alone in the house, the applicant who is her neighbour came inside the house and gave her daughter some intoxicated mixed rice forcibly to eat after which he committed rape on her.
When she came back home, she found her daughter lying unconscious in naked position.
She took her daughter to the doctor where she was given treatment.
opennyai_summary.arguments: Although the victim has named the applicant and stated of his committing rape upon her in her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. but the same is false version as the medical examination report of the victim does not show any injury either on her body or on her private part.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
In so far as the previous application of the applicant given on portal of the Government is concerned, the same is against the first informant.
The victim in no manner would have joined the hands at this age for falsely implicating the applicant and also making her involved in a matter of rape.
opennyai_summary.final__decision: 8. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I do not find it a fit case for bail, hence, the bail application is rejected.
